convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for AnchoredMomentum indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close positions), making it require manual implementation of both the custom indicator logic and trading functions in Python.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

other_exits: Sell position closed when AnchoredMomentum crosses above UpLevel
Buy position closed when AnchoredMomentum crosses below DnLevel

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM value = fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 means 0.1 lots), positive MM value = deposit fraction for risk-based sizing; logic handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses previous bar (Value[1]) vs earlier bar (Value[0]) comparison: for long, Value[1]>UpLevel AND Value[0]<=UpLevel (momentum crossed above level between bar 0 and bar 1 at SignalBar offset). Same logic inverted for short. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from bar index 1 (previous completed bar). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean gates allow independently enabling/disabling entry and exit directions. Recount flag forces signal recalculation on first tick. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: Must implement AnchoredMomentum indicator from its .mq5 source (SMA of price minus EMA of price, normalized). Must replace TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) with Python equivalents. The MM parameter dual-mode logic (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction) must be replicated. SL/TP are in points so need _Point conversion. Signal logic compares two consecutive buffer values at SignalBar offset to detect level crossover.
